skullsanctum.book.start.text: Skull Sanctum turns sacrifices into souls and souls into decorative heads. Build a small sanctum around a Sacrificial Altar, burn what you can spare, and buy any of thousands of heads at its Head Atlas.
skullsanctum.book.start.motto: "Every head has its price. The spirits accept souls."
skullsanctum.book.start.step1: Craft a Sacrificial Altar and set it down.
skullsanctum.book.start.step2: Put a cauldron and an enchanting table close to it (see The Sanctum), then right-click the altar.
skullsanctum.book.start.step3: Sacrifice blocks and items at the altar. Their souls fill the Soul Tank.
skullsanctum.book.start.step4: Right-click the Head Atlas (the enchanting table of the awake sanctum) and buy heads with your souls.
skullsanctum.book.start.recipe: A new guide: a book and a wither skeleton skull.
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.text: The heart of the sanctum, as large as an enchanting table. Dark stone with gold-bound corners; its green specks glimmer once a cauldron and an enchanting table stand close to it.
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.mott: "Lay it down and let it go."
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.reci: Gold ingots and crying obsidian over chiseled polished blackstone and soul soil, on polished blackstone bricks.
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.form: Right-click the altar. When a cauldron and an enchanting table stand with it inside a 3×3×3 box, the sanctum awakens: the cauldron becomes the Soul Tank, the enchanting table the Head Atlas. If not, the altar shows a suggested shrine as ghosts for a few seconds.
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.scre: Right-click the awakened altar: put offerings into its nine slots. The screen shows what they give, Sacrifice burns them.
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.thro: Or throw items onto the altar or into the Soul Tank: they burn by themselves, also from droppers and water streams.
skullsanctum.book.sacrificial_altar.brea: The souls go into the tank, as far as it has room. Breaking the tank or the Head Atlas puts the sanctum to sleep again. Sneak and right-click the awake altar to see what its shrine still lacks.
skullsanctum.book.soul_tank.text: The sanctum's cauldron, filled with bubbling souls. It holds %s souls and burns with a green flame after every sacrifice.
skullsanctum.book.soul_tank.recipe: Not crafted: the cauldron of the sanctum turns into it when the sanctum awakens.
skullsanctum.book.soul_tank.screen: Right-click the tank: the slot in the cauldron shows its souls as a stack. Take from it, or put soul items into it; shift-click moves a stack either way.
skullsanctum.book.soul_tank.hopper: Items thrown into the tank are sacrificed. Hoppers and pipes cannot reach the souls.
skullsanctum.book.soul_tank.break: Breaking the tank, or the sanctum, drops its souls and gives the cauldron back.
skullsanctum.book.soul.text: The sanctum's currency. Souls can be kept in the tank or carried and stored in chests like any item. Sacrificed again, a soul gives one soul.
skullsanctum.book.soul.motto: "Light as a breath, heavy as a debt."
skullsanctum.book.soul.recipe: Not crafted: the Sacrificial Altar makes souls from sacrifices.
skullsanctum.book.soul.use: The Head Atlas pays with the souls in the sanctum's tank first, then with the souls you carry.
skullsanctum.book.portable_atlas.text: A skull with soul-green eyes. Set down, it floats and turns, souls circle it, and it whispers and laughs now and then. Bound to a sanctum, it is that sanctum's Head Atlas anywhere: in any place, in any dimension.
skullsanctum.book.portable_atlas.recipe: A skeleton skull between four ender pearls and four souls.
skullsanctum.book.portable_atlas.bind: Right-click an awake Sacrificial Altar with the skull in hand: it is bound to that sanctum. Its tooltip names the altar.
skullsanctum.book.portable_atlas.place: Set it down wherever you like. A right click opens the sanctum's Head Atlas for any player, paid with the souls in the sanctum's tank first, then with the buyer's own.
skullsanctum.book.portable_atlas.break: Break it to take it with you, quickest with an axe: it stays bound. While its sanctum sleeps or its altar is gone, it says so and opens nothing.
skullsanctum.book.sanctum.text: The altar only needs a cauldron and an enchanting table that fit with it into a 3×3×3 box. Everything else is decoration: the altar suggests a small shrine of blackstone and shows it as ghosts.
skullsanctum.book.sanctum.back: The floor: three by three polished blackstone bricks, some of them cracked, two gilded blackstone.
skullsanctum.book.sanctum.front: On it, at the back: gilded blackstone, the cauldron and bricks. In front of them: the altar, a wither skeleton skull and the enchanting table.
skullsanctum.book.sanctum.form: Above the back row: a wall on each side with a slab on top, and an upside-down stair over the cauldron. The shrine faces the player who set the altar down.
skullsanctum.book.sacrifices.text: Every item can be sacrificed. What it gives depends on how rare it is; the altar's screen shows the value before anything burns.
skullsanctum.book.sacrifices.common: Stone, earth, wood and everything common give little: a stack is about a soul.
skullsanctum.book.sacrifices.ores: Metals and gems give more, their blocks nine times as much.
skullsanctum.book.sacrifices.trophies: Mob trophies and treasures give the most.
skullsanctum.book.sacrifices.rarity: Rare items without a value of their own give souls by their rarity.
skullsanctum.book.sacrifices.fraction: Fractions of a soul are not lost: the altar keeps them for the next sacrifice.
skullsanctum.book.heads.text: The enchanting table of an awake sanctum becomes the Head Atlas. Right-click it to buy heads: the classic MHF heads, any player's head, and over 86,000 more from the Heads Database, sorted into categories from alphabet to plants.
skullsanctum.book.heads.browse: Pick a category on the left or search by name and tag. The number beside a category is its price in souls.
skullsanctum.book.heads.buy: Click a head to pick it, then Buy; while Shift is held the button buys a stack of 64.
skullsanctum.book.heads.favourite: Right-click a head to keep it under Favourites.
skullsanctum.book.heads.player: Type a player's name into the search: their head comes first, for %s souls.
skullsanctum.book.heads.pay: Heads are paid with the souls in the tank first, then with the souls you carry.
